summary.en: When two waves overlap they add together point by point — interference — and a wave passing through a narrow opening spreads out into the region behind it — diffraction.
summary.et: Kui kaks lainet kattuvad, liidetakse need punkt-punktilt kokku — interferents — ning kitsast avast läbiv laine levib laiali selle taga olevasse alasse — difraktsioon.
